mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has been above 4.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market that boosts corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST has increased, or the Rank IC for HOUST in late-cycle expansion is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) consistently signals a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has declined, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0 for two consecutive months, it indicates a significant manufacturing contraction that triggers recession fears, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO has fallen below 105.0 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST rising and RSAFS rising) fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a rebound in manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during post-recession recovery when INDPRO has increased, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in post-recession recovery is below 0.03.
